structural_scope: Three excluded outcomes remain explicitly unexecuted: SELECT R4 is constant one; SELECT reloads its own just-written seven rather than minus three; FLIP R14 remains one across the layout callee that saves/restores it. Immutable literals/code, distinct valid stack/RAM/MMIO and synchronous software entry apply. No concurrent external RAM writer is modeled.
scope: Original interrupt/completion/buffer family and existing arithmetic/copy adapters, with full reached/final machine/RAM/FPU/banks/MACH/MACL/GBR, eight-MiB VRAM, IRQ acknowledge state, register/queue/packet state and every timer/busy input matched. limitations: Direct software entry/callback tests do not establish hardware IRQ delivery, acceptance/vectoring, physical DMA/GPU execution, timing, visible pixels or natural startup.

Bounded 32-bit VRAM aperture and normal-event write-one-to-clear acknowledgement only. Other VRAM apertures and full device semantics are not implemented. Finite busy/timer samples are explicit peripheral inputs; exhaustion stops with -4.

Original waits are unbounded without the research define. The research callback waits permit 64 continued tests, while transfer retry/reset limits remain two; no successful game return is fabricated by a limit.

Runtime table/buffer and CPU state fixtures, inherited immutable code/literal, distinct stack/data and qualified numeric/MMU-off domains apply. All ports, gameplay and requested graphics/settings goals remain unfinished.
